THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER PROVISO (b) TO SECTION 38
Order No. 12 of 2025

My Ref. No.: 4-3/18/2019/WS/623.Divisional Secretary's. No.: KDS/KGK/4/2/(4)2019/02/04. BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (b) to Section 38 of Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare by this order that the lands referred to in Paragraph I of the Schedule are subjected to the servitude speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph II of that Schedule. K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/06,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,08th January, 2025.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER PROVISO (a) TO SECTION 38
Order No. 271 of 2021
My Ref. No.: 4-3/18/2019/WS/623.Divisional Secretary's. Ref. No.: KDS/KGK/4/2/(4)2019/02/04.

The Order No. 271 of 2021 under Proviso (a) to Section 38 has been published in the Gazette Extraordinary of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 2259/27 dated 23.12.2021 with errors. Therefore, Order No. 271 of 2021 is hereby cancelled as per the provisions in Section 18 (Chater. 12) of Interpretation Ordinance as amended by
Interpretation (Amendment) Act, No. 18 of 1972 and No. 29 of 1974.
K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
